thread:
Nina S.: Datadog PM asked for a lightweight observability pack for our marketplace tile: traces, infra, GPU health, and a couple dashboards. Can we scope it?

Omar K.: We should provide an otel collector config that supports OTLP->Datadog and a sidecar path for Private installs. Keep batch time small to avoid adding latency.

Tess W.: Also include GPU metrics: MIG slices, GPU memory per container, and a small exporter for cache hit/miss per model (redwood.kv.*).

Omar K.: Example collector snippet I recommend: ```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
      http:
processors:
  batch:
    timeout: 150ms
    send_batch_size: 50
exporters:
  datadog: {}
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

Nina S.: Good. Add sampling guidance: tail-based for long chains (>=50 tokens or >400ms), and light head sampling for short prompts.

Tess W.: I'll draft a compact dashboard (<=6 widgets): per-model p50/p95 latency, GPU utilization + MIG breakdown, KV cache hit rate, batching queue depth, and fallback/error rate.

Omar K.: Include a tiny demo trace generator for partners to exercise fallbacks. Put examples/trace-gen and README with a one-click install note. 

deploy-bot: Branch created: feature/obs-marketplace-pack-1852 (https://git.internal/redwood/marketplace/compare/feature/obs-marketplace-pack-1852)

Nina S.: Action owners: Tess -> dashboard JSON + sample queries; Omar -> collector + README + sidecar notes; Nina -> partner kickoff and co-marketing sync. Flag blockers here.
